## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Dàshèng liúzhuǎn zhūyǒu jīng* (T577) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by Yìjìng 義淨 ([義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8)). It is another rendering of the *Bhava-saṅkrānti* corpus already represented at [KR6i0207](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0207) (Bodhiruci I) and [KR6i0208](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0208) (Buddhaśānta). Yìjìng's version is later, more idiomatically Tang-dynasty Buddhist Chinese, and reflects his characteristic terminological choices for *bhava*, *vijñāna*, and *pratibimba*.

**Abstract**

A short doctrinal sūtra on the transmigration of consciousness (*vijñāna*) through the three realms of existence (*tribhava*), explained by the simile of a reflection that transmits without substantial transfer. Translation datable within Yìjìng's main Cháng'ān translation period 700–711 CE (after his return from India in 695 and before his death in 713).
